newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DECEUNINCK SEES SHARPLY HIGHER TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: DECEUNINCK SEES SHARPLY HIGHER TURNOVER.

text.p: Belgian polyvinyl chloride (PVC) profiles producer Deceuninck Plastics Industries NV said on Friday it expected 1997 consolidated turnover to exceed eight billion Belgian francs, up from 5.9 billion in 1996.

The company said it recently obtained U.S. authorities' approval to buy Dayton Technologies Inc, a Monroe, Ohio, based producer of extruded profiles for vinyl windown and patio door markets from Aluminum Co of America (Alcoa .

This year would be a transitional year in which "the important acquisitions" of Dayton and Slocomb of the U.K. would be integrated in the group and its position in eastern Europe strengthened further, it said in a statement.
"Although in the short term this will lead to additional investment and costs in sales, research and development and promotion, the outlook for the coming years is optimistic."
